description: This file defines the LocationDecorator class within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides methods to set and get location-related data, interact with associated services like LocationService and CountryService, and manipulate Location entities, such as setting the country by code and retrieving the number of employees at a location.

classes.name: LocationDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class that adds additional behaviors and helpers for Location entities, integrating with services and providing methods for setting related data such as country and fetching employee counts.

methods.name: setLocationService
methods.description: Sets the LocationService instance used by this decorator.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Retrieves the LocationService instance, creating a new one if none was set.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a Location entity.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Protected helper to retrieve the Location entity associated with this decorator.

methods.name: setCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country for the location based on a provided country code, using the CountryService.

methods.name: getNoOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns the number of employees in the location via LocationService.
